name: Elda (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Elda (a castle beneath a fleur-de-lis on red, within a green wreath and beneath a crown).
history: The flag, like the arms approved in 1965, is used without formal registration; a flag bearing the arms of Elda is first recorded in 1705 during the War of the Spanish Succession.

features.role: Elda arms — castle and fleur-de-lis within a wreath
